column11: JUDGEMENT on uniQure's filed timetable. GenTLE (NCT06063850) is a Phase I/IIa with primary completion 2026-11-30 on the registry, and a Phase III is still to come: the contingent consideration owed to uniQure France's former shareholders is valued on 'AMT-260 advancing into a Phase III clinical study', and the milestones 'associated with Phase III development and the approval of AMT-260 in the U.S. and European Union' are expected to 'become payable between 2030 and 2034' (Q2 2026 10-Q, 0001104659-26-087815). A Phase III started in 2027 that reads out in 2030, an original BLA under standard review (ten months after a 60-day filing period, data/fda_review_clock.csv) and approval in 2031 to 2032 put the first full year in 2033, inside uniQure's own window
